title: Hybrid Ranking and Adaptive Retrieval
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of BM25, weighted fusion, adaptive-k, and relevance gate, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in college-faq-chatbot-rag.
learning_objectives: Explain BM25, weighted fusion, adaptive-k, and relevance gate in plain language and connect it to src/retriever.py; src/query_normalizer.py.
Trace one input through the hybrid ranking and adaptive retrieval stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: BM25, weighted fusion, adaptive-k, and relevance gate
practical_outcomes: Trace the hybrid ranking and adaptive retrieval stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for BM25, weighted fusion, adaptive-k, and relevance gate.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
